title: The Sculpted Armor Canon
summary: A canon on sculpting armor gauntlets and great fists of qi about the body and using them as weapons.

title: Treatise on Spawned Hosts
summary: A treatise on spawning small hosts of qi-made servants that strike guard and mend at the user's word.

title: Manual of the Made Wings
summary: A manual on making wings of qi at the shoulders for lift for striking and for sheltering behind.

title: Canon of the Wright and His Tools
summary: A canon on making the tools of a wright in the field from chains and spears to snares and draughts that mend.

title: Treatise of Nascent Forces
summary: A treatise on making forces that are just born and sending them out before they have taken a settled shape.

title: Manual of the Fount of Making
summary: A manual on opening a fount of new qi in the body and drawing from it to strike to mend and to restore.
